name: Vintage Story
description: Uncompromising wilderness survival sandbox with deep crafting. Official server tarball downloaded from cdn.vintagestory.at.

variables.label: Vintage Story version
variables.description: Exact stable version, e.g. 1.20.1 — used in the download URL. Re-run install after changing it.

notes: Recent server tarballs bundle a self-contained .NET runtime, so no dotnet install is needed on the host. All server data (serverconfig.json, Saves/, Logs/, Mods) lives under ./data thanks to --dataPath, so panel backups capture worlds. Console commands start with '/' — '/stop' saves and shuts down gracefully.
